## Heading ending in \#

Stars \*like this\*, under_scores, \_leading and trailing\_, \[brackets\], \`ticks\`, \~tildes\~ and a back\\slash.

\# not a heading
1\. not a list
\- not a bullet
\+ not a bullet either
\> not a quote
\: not a definition
\---

Markup-looking text: \<div> and \&copy; and \@{mention} and user\@example.com, https\://example.com and www\.example.com.

Punctuation <strong>"quoted"</strong>next to strong, and *(parenthesised)*.

``a `tick` inside`` and `` `leading ``

| a \| b | `c\|d` |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 2 |
